verify.subject: Confirm your Inkline email
verify.intro: Welcome to Inkline! Confirm your email address to finish creating your account.
verify.outro: This link works for 24 hours. If you didn't sign up for Inkline, you can ignore this email.

reset.subject: Reset your Inkline password
reset.intro: We got a request to reset your Inkline password. Use the button below to choose a new one.
reset.outro: This link works for 1 hour. If you didn't ask for this, you can ignore this email and your password stays the same.

login.title: Log in
login.verified: Email confirmed. You can log in now.
login.resetDone: Password changed. Log in with your new password.
login.verificationResent: We sent a new confirmation email.

signup.title: Sign up
signup.lead: Create your free account. The first {freeEpisodes} episodes of every series are free.
signup.checkEmail: Check your inbox: we sent a confirmation link to {email}. Confirm your email to finish signing up.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.lead: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way. It works for 1 hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.lead: Pick a new password for your account.

twoFactor.lead: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.backupLead: Enter one of your backup codes. Each works once.

errors.invalidInput: Check your details: enter your name, a valid email and a password of at least {min} characters.
errors.emailNotVerified: Confirm your email first: we sent you a link when you signed up.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait about 10 minutes and try again.
errors.captcha: We couldn't verify you're human. Try again.
errors.captchaPending: Wait for the human check to finish, then try again.
errors.invalidToken: This link is invalid or has expired.
errors.invalidCode: That code didn't work. Check it and try again.
errors.social: We couldn't log you in with that account. Try again or use your email.

twoFactor.backupCodesHint: Save these somewhere safe. Each code works once if you lose your phone.
